newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan stock market indices at new highs.
newsitem.headline: Milan stock market indices at new highs.

text.p: The key cash and futures indices on the Milan bourse hit fresh record highs in mid-morning trading on Monday.
The all-share Mibtel index rose 0.29 percent to a high of 14,058 with the blue chip Mib30 index jumping 0.24 percent to 21,431.
The Fib30 September stock index futures contract leapt to an all-time him 21,615 before easing slightly to 21,610. Milan newsroom +392-66102321
